description: Full-length frontal portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe dressed in black wearing a skull cap standing on a cement floor in the apex of a corner wall; her hair is concealed under a black skull cap, hands and arms are behind her back, she wears a white collared shirt open at the neck under a black vest with buttons, a long sleeve black jacket with lapels and a black shirt with nylons and black loafers.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe, New York
